title: Clicking a card opens the work order except on its more-actions button
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011). A desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  • [User-A]: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • One technician at this location: [Tech-A] (e.g. "Esther Howard"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Card Click" (used by this case only), with one contact and one asset, so this case's work orders are kept apart from every other work order at the location.
  • One Approved work order for that customer, [WO-1], led by [Tech-A].
  • Names and numbers are examples.

Setup

  1. Sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page (you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  2. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm each technician below is active at this location with Time Clock on, or add it: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] (e.g. Esther Howard).
  3. Top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Card Click" > Save (if it already exists, open it instead). On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, TRK-118) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  4. Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Card Click" and its asset > Save. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open: in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; the build offers only ready-made lines), turn Line Approved on > Save & Close; the work order becomes Approved. Repeat for one work order only; record its number as [WO-1] (the expected results call it "S1-702") (numbers on this site look like "S10043-17581").
  5. Set the leads: on an Approved work order pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned. Here: [WO-1] = [Tech-A].
  6. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search ZZAUTOTEST F2 Card Click — [WO-1] shows, led by [Tech-A]. If not, set the lead before starting.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab, click Search and type ZZAUTOTEST F2 Card Click.
  2. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (tooltip "Board View").
  3. Click the customer name on the [WO-1] card.
  4. Press the browser Back button.
  5. Click an empty part of the card.
  6. Press the browser Back button.
  7. Hover the card and click its more-actions button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Clicking the customer name or empty space on the card opens work order S1-702.
  • Clicking the more-actions button opens its menu and does not open the work order.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View — board by lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S3-R6, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions 853901313 DR-39.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R6: “Clicking a card (outside the more-actions control) opens the work order.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
